data: Is the classifier evaluated on 15 types of Twitter users?

The caption mentions that the classifier is trained and tested on balanced sets of agreed-upon Twitter users of a given role, and the question asks if the classifier is evaluated on 15 types of Twitter users. The x-axis of the figure lists 15 different roles: Artist, Athlete, Blogger, Cheerleader, Christian, DJ, Filmmaker, Host, Performer, Producer, Smoker, Stoner, Student, Teacher. Therefore, the classifier is indeed evaluated on 15 types of Twitter users.
